import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if w <= 3:
        print("YES")
        return

    # compute bases (powers of w) up to 2e9
    bases = []
    val = 1
    while val <= 2_000_000_000:
        bases.append(val)
        val *= w
    nDigits = len(bases)

    values = [-1] * nDigits
    curTotal = -sum(bases)  # all coefficients are -1 initially
    works = False
    break_outer = False

    while True:
        index = 0
        while True:
            values[index] += 1
            curTotal += bases[index]
            if values[index] != 2:
                if abs(curTotal) == m:
                    works = True
                break
            else:
                values[index] = -1
                curTotal -= 3 * bases[index]
                index += 1
                if index == nDigits:
                    break_outer = True
                    break
        if break_outer:
            break

    print("YES" if works else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
